title: Notes service: one admin route skips the admin check

planted.why: /admin/export returns every user's notes without calling auth.require_admin, unlike /admin/users

proof.python:
import app
r = app.handle({'path': '/admin/export', 'method': 'GET', 'token': 'tok-alice', 'body': None})
assert r['status'] == 200 and 'root' in r['body'], r
